initial_plan.answerability: partly: the file can describe reported pedestrian harm in Brooklyn crashes since 2013, but has no walking-exposure or other risk denominator
initial_plan.metric: annual reported pedestrian casualties, number_of_pedestrians_injured plus number_of_pedestrians_killed
initial_plan.population: people reported injured or killed as pedestrians in police-reported crashes assigned to Brooklyn
filters: crash year 2013 through latest year represented
initial_plan.years: 2013 through latest year represented in file

answerability: partly: the file can describe annual police-reported pedestrian casualties in Brooklyn crashes, but cannot establish overall pedestrian road safety because it contains no pedestrian-exposure denominator
metric: annual reported pedestrian casualties, the sum of number_of_pedestrians_injured and number_of_pedestrians_killed across Brooklyn crashes
denominator: none; a count, not adjusted for population, pedestrian trips, or miles walked
population: people reported injured or killed as pedestrians in police-reported motor-vehicle crashes assigned to Brooklyn
filters: borough, trimmed and case-insensitive, equals Brooklyn
the two outcome fields are nonmissing; the data check found no missing values in the final Brooklyn population
years: calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; exclude 2026 because the file covers only January 1 through June 11

missing_value_handling_and_decisions.crash_date: No missing dates were found; exclude dates outside the final 2013-2025 period.
missing_value_handling_and_decisions.borough: In the final period, 659,713 of 2,132,218 dated crash rows (about 30.9%) have borough missing, empty, or unknown and cannot be assigned to Brooklyn; exclude them from the Brooklyn population. No unrecognized borough values were found. Brooklyn is selected case-insensitively after trimming.
missing_value_handling_and_decisions.outcomes: The two pedestrian outcome fields have no missing values among the 473,801 Brooklyn crash rows in the final period; no rows are excluded for outcome missingness and no missing value is treated as zero.
missing_value_handling_and_decisions.partial_year: Exclude 2026 from annual comparisons: the file runs only through June 11, 2026 (36,424 dated crashes across the city, including 9,700 Brooklyn crashes), rather than a full calendar year.

data_check_summary: All years 2013-2025 have records spanning January 1 through December 31. This endpoint check does not prove that every day or every report is complete. Borough assignment is unavailable for about 30.9% of dated crashes in the final period; these cannot be allocated to Brooklyn.
plan_change_after_data_check: The initial plan included every year through the latest year in the file. The check found 2026 covers only January 1-June 11, so the final plan excludes 2026 rather than plotting a partial year alongside full annual totals.
